name: Pass Optimization
purpose: Optimize compiler pass compile-time performance by selecting, benchmarking, profiling, and improving one pass at a time.
summary: This bounded-autonomous agent uses measured, artifact-backed inventory, inspection, and focused verification to select and test one compiler-pass optimization at a time.

tools.name: pass-optimization-inventory
tools.purpose: Compile one explicit bounded benchmark, strictly parse adjacent -vv timings, and rank recognized passes.

tools.name: pass-optimization-inspect
tools.purpose: Inspect one explicit pass and workload using bounded source, test, documentation, and history evidence.

tools.name: pass-optimization-verify
tools.purpose: Measure explicit revisions in isolated worktrees and decide retain or reject from timing and correctness evidence.
